plugins.name: Bark Push
plugins.description: Push RSS article summaries to iOS/macOS via Bark (official api.day.app or self-hosted server), formatted like Telegram Compact Card.

description_i18n.en: Push RSS article summaries to iOS/macOS via Bark (official api.day.app or self-hosted server), formatted like Telegram Compact Card.
description_i18n.zh: 通过 Bark 向 iOS/macOS 推送文章摘要卡片（参考 Telegram 摘要模式排版，支持官方 api.day.app 与自建服务端）。

versions.changelog:
# 0.3.1

- Initial release of the official **Bark Push** single-file JS channel plugin (`Plugin API v1`).
- Formats iOS/macOS notifications in FeedCourier's **Telegram Compact Card (摘要模式)** style: concise headline, clean summary with duplicate-title suppression, compact editorial footer (`— Source · Author · YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`), tap-to-open article URL, and optional HTTPS feed favicon.
- Supports official `https://api.day.app` as well as self-hosted Bark servers with optional HTTP Basic Auth, interruption levels (`active`, `timeSensitive`, `passive`, `critical`), custom notification group, and custom sound.

plugins.name: Link Rewrite (YOURLS)
plugins.description: Rewrite outgoing article links using one or more self-hosted YOURLS short-link providers at delivery time, with SQLite caching, domain exclusions, and optional strict retry mode.

description_i18n.en: Rewrite outgoing article links using one or more self-hosted YOURLS short-link providers at delivery time, with SQLite caching, domain exclusions, and optional strict retry mode.
description_i18n.zh: 在推送渲染阶段通过一个或多个自建 YOURLS 短链服务重写文章链接，内置 SQLite 缓存、域名排除规则与可选严格重试模式。

plugins.name: ntfy Push
plugins.description: Deliver RSS articles as push notifications to ntfy.sh or self-hosted ntfy servers with topic, priority, tags, click URL, and optional bearer token auth.

description_i18n.en: Deliver RSS articles as push notifications to ntfy.sh or self-hosted ntfy servers with topic, priority, tags, click URL, and optional bearer token auth.
description_i18n.zh: 将 RSS 文章推送到 ntfy.sh 或自建 ntfy 服务器，支持自定义主题、优先级、标签、点击跳转链接与可选 Bearer Token 认证。

versions.changelog:
# 0.3.1

- Migrated `ntfy` from the legacy out-of-process HTTP Bridge sidecar to a single-file ES Module (`plugin.js`, Plugin API v1) running directly inside FeedCourier's sandboxed JS runtime.
- Preserved all hardening rules: strict `server_url` normalization (rejects embedded credentials, strips query/fragment and trailing slashes), RFC 2047 UTF-8 Base64 `Title` encoding for non-ASCII titles, code-point-safe `<= 4096` UTF-8 byte truncation, and `429` (`Retry-After`) / `5xx` / `4xx` retry mapping.
